gapLegend: Share of members missing each skill for the target role.

funding.title: Training budgets
funding.description: Set a yearly training budget for each member. When you compare packages, Adept builds one option that stays within these budgets. Your organisation pays for the training directly.

packages.title: Compare team learning packages
packages.description: Choose a target role and cohort, then compare course plans for each member. The default role uses existing skill fit, not the largest missing-skills gap.
packages.policy: Packages are proposals with estimated time and dated list prices. Choosing one sends it to members to review; it does not enrol them or buy courses. Your organisation buys the courses.
packages.summary: Estimated team total RM {cost} · Up to {weeks} weeks · {gaps} skills still unmet across members
packages.withinBudget: Fits the currently available member budgets.
packages.overBudget: Some members exceed their available budget. Adjust funding before any purchase.
packages.memberTime: {hours} study hours at {weekly} h/week · Available employer budget RM {available}
packages.unmet: Skills this course package cannot close
packages.acceptHint: Review the courses and remaining gaps. Accepting adds it as a work programme in this organisation; your personal plan stays as it is. It does not purchase courses or approve funding.

programmes.listDesc: Start from a business objective. Adept proposes a route per person from the verified catalogue; people review and accept. Nothing is enrolled, bought or approved automatically.
programmes.emptyDesc: Create one from a business objective: Adept suggests learning routes towards roles; people choose.
programmes.newDesc: Tell Adept what the business needs. It proposes a personal route for each person; you review before anything is sent.
programmes.stale: Members, prices or budgets changed since this plan was made. Generate it again before sending.
programmes.sentBody: Each person now reviews their learning agreement and can accept or ask for a change. You will see their answers on the programmes page.
programmes.generationFailed: The programme could not be built. Your brief is saved on this page; try again.
programmes.sendFailed: We could not confirm that the programme was sent. Check the programme list before trying again.

programmes.stageBudget: Checking the programme budget and individual limits
programmes.stageTimeline: Checking each route against the target date
